form.label: Ingest vs search
form.description: Stoker's delivered ingest and Regulator's search latency on one timeline, for a test that drives both at once: did search latency move when ingest hit its rate, and did Splunk queue searches while it was indexing? Reads Stoker's dogfood telemetry (stoker:metrics, stoker:job) and Regulator's (regulator:sample, regulator:lifecycle); each tool's index is set separately.

search.query: index=$sidx$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | stats latest(_time) as t, latest(spec_id) as spec_id by run_id | sort - t | eval label="run ".run_id." (spec ".spec_id.")"

index=$ridx$ sourcetype=regulator:lifecycle kind=run_created | stats latest(_time) as t, latest(run_label) as run_label, latest(scenario) as scenario by run_no | sort - t | eval label=run_label." (".scenario.")"

(index=$sidx$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$srun$) OR (index=$ridx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$rrun$ NOT slot=*) | eval ingest_eps=if(sourcetype="stoker:metrics", eps, null()), ingest_mbps=if(sourcetype="stoker:metrics", bps/1048576, null()), target_eps=if(sourcetype="stoker:metrics", target_eps, null()), search_p95_ms=if(sourcetype="regulator:sample", 'interval.p95_ms', null()), search_per_s=if(sourcetype="regulator:sample", 'interval.throughput_per_s', null()), search_queued=if(sourcetype="regulator:sample", 'interval.queued', null()), search_errors=if(sourcetype="regulator:sample", 'interval.errors', null()) | bin _time span=30s | stats sum(ingest_eps) as ingest_eps, sum(target_eps) as target_eps, sum(ingest_mbps) as ingest_mbps, max(search_p95_ms) as search_p95_ms, avg(search_per_s) as search_per_s, sum(search_queued) as search_queued, sum(search_errors) as search_errors by _time
table _time, ingest_eps, target_eps, search_p95_ms | rename ingest_eps as "ingest eps (Stoker)", target_eps as "target eps", search_p95_ms as "search p95 ms (Regulator)"
eval ingest_mbps=round(ingest_mbps, 2) | table _time, ingest_mbps, search_per_s | rename ingest_mbps as "ingest MB/s (Stoker)", search_per_s as "searches/s (Regulator)"

panel.title: Searches queued in Splunk, and search failures

search.query: table _time, search_queued, search_errors | rename search_queued as "queued", search_errors as "failed"

where isnotnull(search_p95_ms) AND isnotnull(ingest_eps) | eval band=case(ingest_eps<10000, "under 10k eps", ingest_eps<50000, "10k to 50k eps", ingest_eps<100000, "50k to 100k eps", true(), "100k eps and over") | stats count as intervals, median(search_p95_ms) as median_p95_ms, max(search_p95_ms) as worst_p95_ms, sum(search_queued) as queued by band | eval median_p95_ms=round(median_p95_ms, 0), worst_p95_ms=round(worst_p95_ms, 0)

index=$sidx$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$srun$ | stats latest(state) as state, latest(eps) as eps, latest(target_eps) as target_eps, max(lag_s_max) as worst_lag_s, latest(live_workers) as live_workers, latest(hec_5xx) as hec_5xx, latest(hec_timeouts) as timeouts by run_id | eval achieved=if(target_eps>0, round(100*eps/target_eps, 1)."%", "-"), eps=round(eps, 0)

(index=$sidx$ sourcetype=stoker:job run_id=$srun$) OR (index=$ridx$ sourcetype=regulator:lifecycle run_no=$rrun$ kind=run_*) | eval tool=if(sourcetype="stoker:job", "Stoker", "Regulator"), run=if(tool="Stoker", "run ".run_id, run_label), what=if(tool="Stoker", 'from'." to ".'to'.if(isnotnull(end_reason), " (".end_reason.")", ""), kind.if(isnotnull(outcome), " (".outcome.")", "")) | table _time, tool, run, what | sort - _time | head 100
